scope: National agricultural planning benchmarks from published FAOSTAT observations, not field measurements or live prices. Published moisture basis and comparable production costs are unavailable.
methodology: Positive observations from 2021 onwards. Use the median of up to three latest paired years if an intersection exists. Otherwise summarize each available metric independently, record its years, and distinguish unaligned benchmarks. Original national reporting flags are retained. Wheat is a proxy shared by all three calendar profiles.
